name: lenis
title: Lenis
responsibility: Smooth scrolling — the scroll backbone for premium landing pages and scroll-driven experiences. Pairs naturally with GSAP ScrollTrigger.
reachFor: Scroll-driven website experiences shared with GSAP/anime onScroll
avoid: App-like surfaces and data tables — native scroll is correct there
Carousels/sliders — that is Embla's job, not page scroll
More than ONE Lenis instance per page (fixed chrome presets must not create their own)
reactWiring: new Lenis({ autoRaf: true }) in a single page-level effect; raf loop or autoRaf; destroy() on unmount; lenis.on('scroll', …) for hooks
